title: Gray Turtleneck Dress & Tan Boots
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair flowing slightly to one side stands in a full-length pose against a pale studio backdrop. She wears a fitted heathered gray ribbed turtleneck mini dress with long sleeves, cinched at the waist with a thin brown leather belt. Tall tan suede knee-high boots with buckle detail and a pointed toe complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light with a glossy floor. Palette of heathered gray, chocolate, and tan. Clean and cozy, in the style of a minimalist winter lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The ribbed knit and tan boots create the warm-neutral contrast.
- Add 'full-length' to keep the boots in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use full-length framing to include the boots.
